steps.text: Look over the panel, its two cables and their connectors.
steps.right_looks_like: Unbroken glass, whole cables, clean connectors.
steps.stop: Stop. If a connector is cracked or scorched, do not use the panel. Go to your site supervisor or engineer.

steps.text: Push the plus connector into the plus socket until it clicks. If you are in a hurry, you can skip the stop.
steps.right_looks_like: The halves are locked with no gap.
